metadata.prompt: Describe this image and judge whether it is physically reasonable.
metadata.reference: Photorealistic outdoor shot of a wooden park bench sitting on grass, the bench four legs sink directly into the dirt and grass blades without any soil displacement or footprints, no text, no watermark.
metadata.rationale: The heavy metal legs penetrate the soil without compressing the dirt or flattening the surrounding grass blades.
